changeSet.sql:
UPDATE document.document d SET buyer_in = COALESCE(u.pinfl, u.tin) FROM "user"."user" u WHERE d.buyer_user_id = u.id AND d.buyer_in IS NULL;
UPDATE document.document d SET seller_in = COALESCE(u.pinfl, u.tin) FROM "user"."user" u WHERE d.seller_user_id = u.id AND d.seller_in IS NULL;
